blocks.text: A scheduled src/drift.py run re-fetches every discovered page and the repository.

sentences.text: A scheduled src/drift.py run re-fetches every discovered page and the repository.

blocks.text: It classifies each difference as known (presentation only) or unknown.

sentences.text: It classifies each difference as known (presentation only) or unknown.

blocks.text:
Every unknown difference becomes a review item, and its snapshot is retained;
   snapshots for known differences are discarded, because nothing was learned.

sentences.text:

blocks.text:
A human reads the retained snapshot beside the recorded one — both are complete
   response bodies, so they can be diffed.

sentences.text:

blocks.text:
An approved correction becomes either a deterministic parser rule or an explicit
   recorded override. It never becomes a hand-edited catalog file.
